$description: Sparkline (platform/charts/Sparkline.jsx; library wave 9, lane C): its component tokens. The line, area, bars and dot take the data-viz color of the sparkline (data-plx-dataviz); everything else is an existing role.

sparkline-default-color.$description: Sparkline: its color without data-plx-dataviz (the first categorical color).

sparkline-inline-width.$description: Sparkline, inline: its width (a word-sized trend in a sentence or a table cell).

sparkline-fill-height.$description: Sparkline, fill: its height (it takes the container's width: a metric card).

sparkline-line-width.$description: Sparkline: the line's stroke (the chart line width).

sparkline-area-opacity.$description: Sparkline, area: the fill under the line, the line's color at low opacity.

sparkline-point-radius.$description: Sparkline: the radius of the dot on the latest value.

sparkline-point-outline.$description: Sparkline: the ring around the latest dot, in the surface color, so it stands off the line.

sparkline-point-outline-width.$description: Sparkline: the latest dot's ring width.
